upgrade.locked: Intake, picks, cost tracking and spot checks are part of the Business plan. You can still view what you already have.

settings.managersOnly: Only owners and admins can change these settings.

buylist.heading: Buylist offers
buylist.description: How much you offer for each card when buying a collection. Offers use your price source and condition values.
buylist.tiersHint: Each card uses the highest tier its market price reaches.
buylist.minCardValueHint: Cards worth less than this aren't taken. Set 0 to take everything.

permissions.heading: Member permissions
permissions.description: What members can do. Owners and admins can always do everything.

acceptIntake.label: Accept or cancel intake lots
acceptIntake.description: Members can always scan into an open lot.

fulfilOrders.label: Create and complete picks
fulfilOrders.description: Completing a pick removes its cards from inventory.

viewActivity.label: See staff activity
viewActivity.description: Throughput per person and the activity log.

intake.title: Intake
intake.subtitle: Scanning into {{collection}} · started {{date}}
intake.newDescription: Cards scanned into the lot's collection are added to it until you accept or cancel it.
intake.emptyDescription: Start one when a customer brings cards to sell.
intake.pickDescription: Choose a lot on the left or start a new one.
intake.noCardsOpen: Open the scanner and sort the customer's cards. Offers update as each card is saved.
intake.noCardsClosed: This lot was closed without any cards.
intake.acceptDescription_one: Buy {{count}} card from {{name}}. Each card's cost basis is set from its offer.
intake.acceptDescription_other: Buy {{count}} cards from {{name}}. Each card's cost basis is set from its offer.
intake.cancelDescription: {{name}} keeps their cards and nothing is paid.
intake.removeCardsHint: Takes them out of the collection, since they leave with the customer.
intake.deleteDescription: The lot's record is removed. Cards you bought stay in your collection with their cost.

collectionModeHints.new: Keeps this customer's cards apart from your stock. Named after the customer.
collectionModeHints.existing: A collection can only have one open lot at a time.

intake.removeCardsHintOwned: Takes them out, since they leave with the customer. The lot's own collection is removed too.

review.startTitle: Go through this lot's cards that haven't been reviewed yet, newest first
review.nothingLeft: Nothing left to review. Every card in this lot has already been reviewed.
review.removeDescription: The card goes back to {{name}} and is taken out of the collection, so the offer goes down.

remove.description: Use this when {{name}} turns down the offer for a card or you pass on it. The cards are taken out of the collection and the offer goes down.

belowMinimum.notice_one: {{count}} card is below your minimum card value of {{value}} and gets no offer.
belowMinimum.notice_other: {{count}} cards are below your minimum card value of {{value}} and get no offer.
belowMinimum.rowTitle: Below your minimum card value, so no offer

receiptPrompt.title: Print a receipt?
receiptPrompt.description: Give {{name}} a receipt for the cards you bought.

orders.subtitle: {{source}} · created {{date}}
orders.importDescription: Paste or upload the cards to pull: a TCGplayer pull sheet, a Shopify order export, any CSV with a card name column, or a plain list like "4 Lightning Bolt".
orders.name: Name
orders.previewEmpty: No cards found. Check that the first row has column names like Product Name and Quantity.
orders.previewSkipped_one: {{count}} row without a card name was skipped.
orders.previewSkipped_other: {{count}} rows without a card name were skipped.
orders.emptyDescription: Create a pick to get a pull sheet with every card's box and position.
orders.pickDescription: Choose a pick on the left or create a new one.
orders.shortLines_one: {{count}} line isn't fully in stock. Re-allocate after scanning more cards, or complete what you have.
orders.shortLines_other: {{count}} lines aren't fully in stock. Re-allocate after scanning more cards, or complete what you have.
orders.decklistCopied: Copied. Paste it into a pick list bin to pull these cards with the sorter.
orders.fulfilDescription_one: Removes {{count}} card from inventory, since it's leaving with the order.
orders.fulfilDescription_other: Removes {{count}} cards from inventory, since they're leaving with the order.
orders.cancelDescription: Its cards stay in inventory and are free for other picks.
orders.deleteDescription: The pick's record is removed. Cards it already took out of inventory stay removed.
orders.pickFirst: Tick the cards you pulled first
orders.fulfilPartialDescription_one: Removes the {{count}} picked card from inventory. The other found cards stay in stock and the pick closes.
orders.fulfilPartialDescription_other: Removes the {{count}} picked cards from inventory. The rest of the {{total}} found cards stay in stock and the pick closes.

cost.title: Set cost basis
cost.description: Record what you paid for the cards in {{name}}.

modeHints.spread: Split across the cards by market value, so valuable cards carry more of the cost.
modeHints.each: Every card gets the same cost.

cost.overwriteHint: Off: only cards without a cost are updated.

reports.noCostAccess: Your role can't see costs and margins. Ask an owner or admin to allow it in Settings > Business.

inventory.uncostedNote_one: {{count}} card has no cost basis, so margins only count costed cards. Use Set cost on a collection to fill it in.
inventory.uncostedNote_other: {{count}} cards have no cost basis, so margins only count costed cards. Use Set cost on a collection to fill it in.
inventory.historyEmptyDescription: Inventory value is recorded once a day.

staff.noAccess: Your role can't see staff activity. Ask an owner or admin to allow it in Settings > Business.

messages.costSet: Set the cost of {{cards}} cards in {{summary}}
messages.accuracyCompleted: Finished a spot check on {{summary}}: {{incorrect}} wrong out of {{checked}}

accuracy.startDescription: Picks random cards from {{name}} for you to compare against the match. The result estimates how accurate the whole batch is.
accuracy.sampleHint: More cards give a tighter estimate.
accuracy.statsNote: Corrections only count mistakes someone noticed. A spot check estimates the ones nobody has looked at yet.
accuracy.noChecksDescription: Check a sample before listing a batch to know how much to trust it.
accuracy.cardGone: This card is no longer in the collection.

fleet.title: Fleet health
fleet.description: Cards sorted, service intervals and alerts for every sorter. Alerts also go to your Discord alerts channel and the sorter.alert webhook.
fleet.intervalDescription: Get an alert when {{name}} has sorted this many cards since its last service.
fleet.noAlertsDescription: Jams, errors, restarts, lost connections and due services show up here.

banner.title: Intake in progress: {{name}}
banner.description: Every card you scan into {{collection}} is added to this lot and kept apart from your stock.

transfer.title: Move the bought cards
transfer.description: Move the cards from {{name}} into the collection where you keep your stock.
transfer.noTargets: No other collection for this game yet, so a new one will be created.
transfer.deleteSourceHint: Only once it has no cards left.
